evals.name: rust-cli-binary-release
evals.prompt: box/cli/foo Rust CLI 바이너리 릴리즈 워크플로우 작성해줘
evals.expected_output: Adds foo to the existing _release-rust-cli.yml (choice option, push path, detect entry) instead of a new workflow; builds the four targets natively on ubuntu-26.04, ubuntu-26.04-arm, and macos-26 runners with no -latest labels; detect reads the version from box/cli/foo/Cargo.toml and skips when box/cli/foo/dist/<version> exists unless force; a push that bumps only box/cli/foo/Cargo.toml releases foo (no push default to ij); gates fmt, clippy, test, coverage before build; archives and SHA256SUMS are committed to box/cli/foo/dist/<version>/ on main; actionlint passes with a .github/actionlint.yaml declaring the ubuntu-26.04 labels, no -ignore flag.

evals.name: drop-qemu
evals.prompt: 컨테이너 이미지 릴리즈 워크플로우에서 QEMU 빼고 arm64 네이티브 러너로 빌드하게 바꿔줘
evals.expected_output: Removes setup-qemu-action; builds each arch on its native runner (amd64 on ubuntu-26.04, arm64 on ubuntu-26.04-arm) and pushes by digest, then a merge job runs docker buildx imagetools create to tag the multi-arch manifest list; runner labels pinned to explicit OS versions; force dispatch instead of package deletion for re-releases; actionlint passes with a .github/actionlint.yaml declaring the ubuntu-26.04 labels.

evals.name: add-scratch-container-project
evals.prompt: box/addons/node-exporter-lite 신규 Rust 에드온 이미지도 릴리즈되게 워크플로우에 추가해줘
evals.expected_output: Adds node-exporter-lite to the existing _release-rust-scratch-containers.yml as a project choice option and a box/addons/node-exporter-lite/Dockerfile push path, plus a ci-rust-projects.json entry; creates no new workflow and no workflow_call caller; leaves the ziglang==0.15.2 and cargo-zigbuild 0.23.0 pins unchanged; actions stay on major tags, not SHAs.
